# Konsel

> A Mac app that puts Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Copilot, Cursor and Kimi in one chat room. When one AI answers, another reviews it and corrects mistakes. Free during the beta.

Konsel is a macOS app by LuluLabs Inc., free during the beta. It runs each AI company's official Mac program (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor CLI, Kimi Code CLI) with the user's own account, so several AIs answer and review each other in one chat. Conversations and memory stay on the user's Mac.

## Facts

- A Mac running macOS 13 or later
- An account with at least one of Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or Kimi. Connect two or more and they check each other. Claude needs a paid plan such as Pro or Max.
- Each answer uses the plan usage of the AI account you connected. Konsel itself charges nothing.

## Questions

### Does it cost anything?
Konsel is free during the beta and may become paid after launch. We will tell you 30 days before. Each AI follows its own company's plans. Claude needs a paid plan such as Pro or Max, ChatGPT also works with a free account, and Grok needs SuperGrok or X Premium+. Each answer uses the plan usage of that account.

### Do I need to sign up?
During the beta you use Konsel without signing up. You sign in to each AI on its company's own sign-in page. Konsel does not receive or store your password.

### Where are my conversations stored?
Only on your Mac. When an AI answers, the conversation is sent to that AI's provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, GitHub, Cursor or Moonshot AI). When you make images or videos, the prompt goes to the creative service you connected, such as Higgsfield. The company that makes Konsel never receives your conversations.

### Can the AIs change my files?
In a chat without a linked folder, the AIs only read files. When you link a folder, the AIs edit a copy of it, and the original changes only when you merge. You can undo a merge. Commands that change files outside the copy or go online ask for your permission first.

### Why does the sign-in page say Claude Code, Codex and so on?
Konsel gets answers through each company's official Mac program: Claude Code from Anthropic for Claude, Codex from OpenAI for ChatGPT, Grok Build from xAI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor CLI and Kimi Code CLI. You sign in with the accounts you already use for each AI.

### What usage data does Konsel send?
Once a day: the app version, the macOS version, the names of the connected AIs, how many messages you sent and answers you got, and at which step and of what type any errors were. Never your conversations, name, email or file paths. It goes to PostHog's servers in Germany. You choose whether to send it when you first open the app, and can change it later in Settings on the My screen.

### How do I report a problem?
Use "Send feedback" on the My screen. In a chat, say "Tell them this is annoying" and the AI opens the feedback window with a draft. You can also press "Report this problem" on an error message. Either way, you press Send yourself.

## 한국어

Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Copilot, Cursor, Kimi를 한 대화방에 연결하는 Mac 앱입니다. 한 AI가 답하면 다른 AI가 검토하고 틀린 부분을 바로잡습니다. 베타 기간에는 무료입니다.
